name: Sorcerer
equipment: (a) a light crossbow and 20 bolts or (b) any simple weapon
(a) a component pouch or (b) an arcane focus
(a) a dungeoneer's pack or (b) an explorer's pack

actions.name: Metamagic
actions.desc: Spend sorcery points on a Metamagic option you know

actions.name: Create Spell Slot
actions.desc: Bonus action: sorcery points into a slot, levels 1-5 cost 2/3/5/6/7

actions.name: Slot to Sorcery Points
actions.desc: Bonus action: expend a slot, gain points equal to its level

1.name: Spellcasting
1.desc: Full caster with innate magic, spells known, CHA.

2.name: Font of Magic
2.desc: Sorcery points (see table, long rest). Bonus action: spend points to create a slot up to 5th (2/3/5/6/7 points), lost at long rest, or expend a slot for points equal to its level.

3.name: Metamagic
3.desc: Two Metamagic options (one more at 10th and 17th), usually one per spell: Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Heightened, Quickened, Seeking, Subtle, Transmuted, Twinned.

10.name: Metamagic
10.desc: Two Metamagic options (one more at 10th and 17th), usually one per spell: Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Heightened, Quickened, Seeking, Subtle, Transmuted, Twinned.

17.name: Metamagic
17.desc: Two Metamagic options (one more at 10th and 17th), usually one per spell: Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Heightened, Quickened, Seeking, Subtle, Transmuted, Twinned.

20.name: Sorcerous Restoration
20.desc: Regain 4 sorcery points on a short rest.

1.name: Psionic Spells
1.desc: Bonus subclass spells at set levels, not counted as known; swap each for a divination or enchantment spell of the same level.

1.name: Telepathic Speech
1.desc: Bonus action: telepathy with a creature within 30 ft, range CHA mod miles, for sorcerer level minutes.

6.name: Psionic Sorcery
6.desc: Cast Psionic Spells with sorcery points equal to the level, without verbal, somatic or unconsumed material components.

6.name: Psychic Defenses
6.desc: Psychic resistance; advantage on saves against charm and fear.

14.name: Revelation in Flesh
14.desc: Bonus action, 10 min, 1 sorcery point per benefit: see invisible within 60 ft, fly and hover, swim at double speed and breathe water, or squeeze through 1 inch and slip bonds.

18.name: Warping Implosion
18.desc: Action: teleport 120 ft; creatures within 30 ft of where you were STR save, 3d10 force and pulled in (half, not pulled, on a success); once per long rest or 5 points.

1.name: Restore Balance
1.desc: Reaction: cancel advantage or disadvantage on a d20 roll of a creature within 60 ft (prof bonus/long rest).

6.name: Bastion of Law
6.desc: Action: 1-5 sorcery points become that many d8 on a creature within 30 ft, spent to reduce damage it takes; lasts until a long rest or a new ward.

14.name: Trance of Order
14.desc: Bonus action, 1 min: no advantage against you, and your d20s of 9 or less count as 10; once per long rest or 5 points.

18.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
18.desc: Action, 30 ft cube: heal up to 100 HP split among chosen creatures, repair objects, end spells of 6th level or lower; once per long rest or 7 points.

1.name: Divine Magic
1.desc: Learn spells from the cleric list too; an affinity (good, evil, law, chaos, neutrality) grants a bonus spell not counted as known.

1.name: Favored by the Gods
1.desc: Add 2d4 to a failed save or missed attack; once per short rest.

6.name: Empowered Healing
6.desc: 1 sorcery point: reroll healing dice of a spell from you or an ally within 5 ft; once per turn.

14.name: Angelic Form
14.desc: Bonus action spectral wings: 30 ft fly speed until dismissed.

18.name: Unearthly Recovery
18.desc: Bonus action below half HP: regain half your HP max; once per long rest.

actions.name: Draconic Presence
actions.desc: Action, 5 points: 60 ft aura of awe or fear for 1 minute (concentration), WIS save DC {dc:CHA}

1.name: Dragon Ancestor
1.desc: Choose a dragon type (sets your element); Draconic language, double proficiency on CHA checks with dragons.

1.name: Draconic Resilience
1.desc: +1 HP per sorcerer level; AC 13 + DEX without armor.

6.name: Elemental Affinity
6.desc: Add CHA to one damage roll of spells of your element; 1 point for resistance to it for 1 h.

14.name: Dragon Wings
14.desc: Bonus action wings: fly speed equal to your speed, not in armor that doesn't fit them.

18.name: Draconic Presence
18.desc: Action, 5 points: 60 ft aura of awe or fear for 1 min (concentration); hostiles starting there WIS save or charmed or frightened.

subclasses.name: Lunar Sorcery
subclasses.source: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

1.name: Moon Fire
1.desc: Sacred Flame as a bonus cantrip, able to hit two creatures within 5 ft of each other.

6.name: Lunar Boons
6.desc: Metamagic costs 1 less on schools of your phase (Full: abjuration, divination; New: enchantment, necromancy; Crescent: illusion, transmutation), prof bonus times per long rest.

6.name: Waxing and Waning
6.desc: Bonus action, 1 point: change phase; cast each phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest while in that phase.

14.name: Lunar Empowerment
14.desc: Full: bonus action light, you and chosen allies in it have advantage on Investigation and Perception. New: advantage on Stealth, attacks against you in darkness at disadvantage. Crescent: necrotic and radiant resistance.

18.name: Lunar Phenomenon
18.desc: Bonus action by phase: Full, CON save or blinded within 30 ft and heal one creature 3d8; New, DEX save 3d10 necrotic and speed 0, you turn invisible; Crescent, teleport 60 ft with a companion and resist all damage. Each once per long rest or 5 points.

1.name: Heart of Fire
1.desc: Casting a fire spell of 1st+ level: chosen creatures within 10 ft take fire equal to half your level (min 1).

6.name: Fire in the Veins
6.desc: Fire resistance; your spells ignore fire resistance.

14.name: Pyromancer's Fury
14.desc: Reaction when hit in melee: fire to the attacker equal to your level, ignoring resistance.

18.name: Fiery Soul
18.desc: Fire immunity; your fire ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance.

1.name: Eyes of the Dark
1.desc: Darkvision 120 ft; at 3rd learn Darkness, castable for 2 points to see through it.

1.name: Strength of the Grave
1.desc: At 0 HP (not from radiant or a crit): CHA save DC 5 + damage to stay at 1 HP; once per long rest.

6.name: Hound of Ill Omen
6.desc: Bonus action, 3 points: a shadow dire wolf hunts one creature within 120 ft for 5 min; while it is adjacent, the target has disadvantage on saves against your spells.

14.name: Shadow Walk
14.desc: Bonus action: teleport 120 ft from dim light or darkness to another such space.

18.name: Umbral Form
18.desc: Bonus action, 6 points, 1 min: resist all but force and radiant, move through creatures and objects (5 force if you end inside).

1.name: Tempestuous Magic
1.desc: Bonus action before or after casting a 1st+ level spell: fly 10 ft without opportunity attacks.

6.name: Heart of the Storm
6.desc: Lightning and thunder resistance; casting such a spell of 1st+ level deals half your level to chosen creatures within 10 ft.

6.name: Storm Guide
6.desc: Stop rain in a 20 ft radius, or steer wind direction in 100 ft each round.

14.name: Storm's Fury
14.desc: Reaction when hit in melee: lightning equal to your level and STR save or pushed 20 ft.

18.name: Wind Soul
18.desc: Lightning and thunder immunity, 60 ft fly; action to give up to 3 + CHA creatures 30 ft fly for 1 h (yours drops to 30); once per short rest.

1.name: Wild Magic Surge
1.desc: After a sorcerer spell of 1st+ level the DM may have you roll d20: a 1 means a roll on the surge table.

1.name: Tides of Chaos
1.desc: Advantage on one attack, check or save; regained at long rest or when the DM calls a surge after a sorcerer spell.

6.name: Bend Luck
6.desc: Reaction, 2 points: add or subtract 1d4 to another creature's attack, check or save.

14.name: Controlled Chaos
14.desc: Roll twice on the surge table and choose.

18.name: Spell Bombardment
18.desc: Once per turn, a spell damage die showing its maximum is rolled again and added.
